description: A type-level `transitions {}` rule targets `.Nonexistent`, which `Phase` does not declare. Per §51.2 the rule references an unknown variant and is rejected with E-ENGINE-004 (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.2 — a type-level `transitions {}` block declares structural rules over the enum's OWN variants. A rule naming a variant the enum does not declare cannot ever match, so it is rejected rather than silently ignored: an unmatchable rule is indistinguishable from a typo, and silently dropping it would leave the author believing a transition is permitted when no rule covers it.
